integrity: The proof independently checks the arbitrary-coordinate extension, the weighted graph-surjection argument, and the odd-parity obstruction. Supporting literature is used only for stated theorems.
scientific_limitations: The constant \(22\) is not claimed optimal; the continuous selector is not claimed Lipschitz; the positive result assumes real scalars, even \(m\ge4\) and \(n\le m^q\). No claim is made about minimal-norm continuous selections in infinite dimensions.
title: Parity-sharp arbitrary-coordinate divergence liftings
